title: Pass the Bread
style: Folk resistance anthem with a weathered lead vocal and communal gang harmonies; acoustic guitar strums and stomping frame drum drive verses that build into a wide singalong chorus, with restrained fiddle fills; steady midtempo pulse; rootsy live-room recording with raw human dynamics.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
They sell us red and blue like tickets at the fair
A headline picks a villain, a pundit points and stares
The mayor shakes a finger, the anchor draws a line
While neighbors count their failures like debts they can assign

[Pre-Chorus]
But I know your hands from the work you do
And you know mine when the hard days come through

[Chorus]
We won't be sorted by a stranger's game
Won't wear a badge just to prove our name
No purity gate, no borrowed shame
We'll stand for the living, not the shouting frame
If they build a wall from a word they twist
We'll pass the bread and refuse the list

[Verse 2]
They turn a private kindness into a public test
Put cameras on compassion, then grade us with the rest
A polished little gesture buys a seat beneath the lights
While quiet folks keep showing up to fix what isn't right

[Pre-Chorus]
No saintly pose can carry us
No perfect tongue can bury us

[Chorus]
We won't be sorted by a stranger's game
Won't wear a badge just to prove our name
No purity gate, no borrowed shame
We'll stand for the living, not the shouting frame
If they build a wall from a word they twist
We'll pass the bread and refuse the list

[Bridge]
Let the loud men trade their thunder
Let the screens repeat their claim
We have fields to tend together
And children to teach their names
A neighbor is not an enemy
For asking how to mend
The door stays wide, the table long
We choose the human end

[Final Chorus]
We won't be sorted by a stranger's game
Won't wear a badge just to prove our name
No purity gate, no borrowed shame
We'll stand for the living, not the shouting frame
If they build a wall from a word they twist
We'll pass the bread and refuse the list
We'll pass the bread and refuse the list

[Outro]
Keep your banners, keep your blame
We are more than a borrowed name
